channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: ‘Everything changed’: The human cost of 25 years of US wars
item.description: Successive wars launched after 9/11 have killed at least 4.5 million people and displaced more than 38 million others.

item.title: Anthropic claims Claude AI used for missile projects, global espionage
item.description: AI was used to develop missile guidance software in Yemen and to power cyber operations, a report alleges.

item.title: Young republicans break with Trump over Iran war
item.description: A clear generational divide between younger and older republicans is forming at the RNC Midterm Convention.

item.title: Putin lands in India for BRICs summit, shadowed by Iran and Ukraine wars
item.description: Russian, Iranian leaders due to hold talks with India's Modi at summit dominated by wars in Middle East and Ukraine.

item.title: Iran claims to have captured a US ‘sail drone’ near Hormuz Strait
item.description: Iran’s Revolutionary Guard says its navy struck a US-operated surface drone at the entrance of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran war live: IRGC attacks US unmanned vessel in Hormuz; two ships hit
item.description: IRGC says it attacked a US unmanned vessel in Hormuz, while UKMTO says projectiles hit two ships off Oman.

item.title: UN envoy warns Security Council Yemen’s war has entered ‘dangerous phase’
item.description: Envoy for Yemen Hans Grundberg demands urgent steps to protect civilians and trade routes amid Houthi escalation.

item.title: Israel says it destroyed Hezbollah base in Lebanon’s Ali al-Taher ridge
item.description: Israeli attacks come a week after it said to have established operational control over the strategic ridge.

item.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
item.description: Mokha's capture would bring the Iran-backed group closer to controlling the Bab al-Mandab Strait waterway, a key shipping route.

item.title: Five killed and 67 injured in Russian strike on shopping centre, Ukraine says
item.description: The attack in Pavlohrad city centre was the third Russian strike on a mall within days, local media report.
